newsitem.title: USA: PG Energy rate increase approved.
newsitem.headline: PG Energy rate increase approved.

text.p: PG Energy, a unit of Pennsylvania Enterprises Inc, said Friday it has signed a settlement agreement allowing it to increase rates, boosting its annual revenues by $7.5 million.
Under the terms, residential rates will increase an average of 4.5 percent, it said, while commercial and industrial rates will decrease an average of 2.4 percent and 5.6 percent, respectively.
The overall increase is 4.1 percent over the rates the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission previously approved.

The projected effective date for the rate increase is January 15, 1997. However, the settlement includes a provision for deferring the billing of the increase for residential heating customers until July 1997, it said.
The company said the new rates move toward giving different customers rates that are more in line with the related cost of providing service.
PG Energy in May filed the base gas rate case, seeking a 9.95 percent increase, which amounted to $14.1 million in additional annual revenue.
